plain_translation: Python cannot find that package on this computer, so the import stops.
checklist_fixes: Open a terminal and run: pip install pygame
If you have multiple Python versions, try: pip3 install pygame
Check you're using the same Python interpreter your editor is using.
If using VS Code, select the correct interpreter (Ctrl+Shift+P → "Python: Select Interpreter").
problem_html: Python says "ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pygame'" when you run your script.
prevention_html: Create a virtual environment: python -m venv venv, then venv\Scripts\activate before installing packages.
keywords: module not found import error pip install pygame ModuleNotFoundError No module named

plain_translation: The display is created before Pygame starts, or the loop never flips the screen.
checklist_fixes: Make sure pygame.init() is called before creating the display surface.
Check you have a game loop with pygame.display.flip() or pygame.display.update() .
Add pygame.event.pump() in your loop to prevent Windows "not responding".
Verify your screen.fill() and draw calls happen before display.flip().
problem_html: Your Pygame window doesn't appear, or appears blank/white. The script runs but nothing is drawn.
prevention_html: Always use this structure: init → create display → game loop → flip → clock.tick. Every frame must call event.pump() and display.flip().
keywords: window not showing display surface blank screen pygame.init

plain_translation: The rectangle used for collision is not moving with the sprite, so the game checks the old position.
checklist_fixes: Make sure both sprites have self.rect = self.image.get_rect() set correctly.
Update self.rect.center = (self.x, self.y) every frame if you move by x/y.
problem_html: Two sprites overlap on screen but your collision code says they don't collide.
prevention_html: Always update the rect after moving the sprite. Use pygame.sprite.groupcollide() for group-vs-group collisions.
keywords: collision not detecting collision detection rect overlap pygame

plain_translation: The mixer needs a click, a supported file, or a different format before it will play.
checklist_fixes: Check the sound file path is correct , use os.path.exists() to verify.
Supported formats: WAV, OGG, MP3. Some MP3 files may not load , try OGG.
Set mixer frequency: pygame.mixer.pre_init(44100, -16, 2) before pygame.init() .
For music vs sound effects: use pygame.mixer.music for background, Sound for SFX.
problem_html: You call pygame.mixer.Sound.play() but no sound is heard. The mixer loads but stays silent.
prevention_html: Use OGG format for small sound effects. Call pygame.mixer.pre_init() before pygame.init() to avoid initialization issues.
keywords: sound not playing mixer audio pygame.mixer music
